signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use your work email and the password you chose.

setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.intro: This password is yours alone. Use at least 12 characters; a short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
setPassword.done: Your password is saved. You can sign in now.

twoFactor.enrolIntro: Your role needs a second check at sign-in. Install an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator on your phone, then confirm your password to begin.
twoFactor.scanTitle: Scan this with your authenticator app
twoFactor.scanIntro: Open the app, choose “Add account” and scan the square. If the camera doesn't work, type the key below by hand.
twoFactor.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, sign in with one of these codes. Each code works only once. Write them down or save them somewhere private.
twoFactor.verifyTitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.verifyIntro: Open the app on your phone and type the 6-digit code shown for Shakti Prime.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.done: Your password is changed. Other devices are signed out.

forgotPassword.title: Get a new password link
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your work email. If it belongs to a staff account, we'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.done: If this email belongs to a staff account, a link is on its way. It works for one hour. Check your inbox, and your spam folder too.

shell.paletteInput: Type the name of a page
shell.paletteEmpty: No page has that name. Check the spelling and try again.

home.allCompanies: Company: all companies you can see

hint.leads: Find and follow up the leads you can see.
hint.newLead: Add a customer who called or walked in as a new lead.
hint.priceMaster: See the current price of every item.
hint.imports: Bring in records from a spreadsheet file.
hint.adminUsers: Invite staff, change their roles and sign them out.
hint.adminActivity: See who changed what, and when.
hint.settingsCompanies: Change each company's brand name and UPI ID.
hint.design: See every colour, text size and control in both themes.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro: How the screens look for you, and your password.

setPassword.subject: Your Shakti Prime sign-in
setPassword.body:
Hello {name},

Your Shakti Prime access is ready. Open this link to choose your password:
{url}

The link works for one day. If you didn't expect this email, you can ignore it.

Shakti Prime

resetPassword.subject: Choose a new Shakti Prime password
resetPassword.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to choose a new password for Shakti Prime:
{url}

The link works for one hour, and only the newest link works. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays as it is.

Shakti Prime

signInAttempts.subject: Someone tried to sign in to your Shakti Prime account
signInAttempts.body:
Hello {name},

Someone has entered a wrong password for your Shakti Prime account several times. If it was you, there is nothing to do. If it wasn't, tell your manager today and change your password from the home screen.

Shakti Prime

twoFactorReset.subject: Your Shakti Prime authenticator app was reset
twoFactorReset.body:
Hello {name},

An Executive has reset the authenticator app on your Shakti Prime account, and you have been signed out everywhere. Sign in again with your password and set up the authenticator app on your phone when Shakti Prime asks you to. If you didn't ask for this, tell your manager today.

Shakti Prime

dialog.intro: The new price applies to quotes made from now on. Quotes already made keep their price.

leads.intro: The leads you can see, with the most recent change first.
leads.caption: Leads

new.name: Customer name
new.nameHelper: Full name, as the customer writes it
new.accountNameHelper: Leave it empty to use the customer's name

users.title: Team members
users.intro: Everyone who can sign in, their role in each company and how they sign in.

users.empty: No one else is on the team yet. Invite the first person.

rolesField.helper: Choose No access for a company this person does not work in.

inviteDialog.intro: They get an email with a link to choose their password. The link works for one day.
inviteDialog.name: Full name

rolesDialog.intro: They are signed out on every device and sign in again with the new roles.

suspendDialog.intro: They are signed out on every device and can't sign in until someone reactivates them.
suspendDialog.reasonHelper: Optional. Kept in the activity log.

reactivateDialog.title: Reactivate {name}
reactivateDialog.intro: They can sign in again with their own password.

resetDialog.intro: Do this only after you have confirmed who is asking, by phone or in person. Someone who only sends a message or an email may not be who they say they are.

liftLockDialog.title: Lift the sign-in lock for {name}
liftLockDialog.intro: Do this only after you have confirmed who is asking, by phone or in person. They can try their password again straight away.

sessions.title: Sign-ins for {name}
sessions.intro: The devices this person has signed in from, newest first. Sign out any you don't recognise.

upload.fileHelper: A CSV file or an Excel file saved as .xlsx, up to {megabytes} MB and {rows} rows. Put the column headings in the top row.
